Author: dajoey
Name: PvP Solver
Description: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Changelog:
v0.1.2.4 - 2026-10-22: Upstream sync (RotationSolverReborn 79f60d87c) - all 21 PvP rotations now carry the 'Reborn' rotation-type tag, upstream's marker for rotations written for the pre-Evercold job kits. Metadata only; no gameplay change.
v0.1.0.13 - 2026-08-25: Adds a "PvPHighestPressure" targeting mode that focuses whichever enemy your own team is already piling onto, and target stickiness so auto-target stops abandoning an enemy while your own timed debuff (Wildfire and similar) is still ticking on it. Both requested in issue #4.
v0.1.0.12 - 2026-08-06: Upstream sync (RotationSolverReborn 35ceb6e82) - all 21 PvP rotations now declare GameVersion 7.55. Metadata-only; no gameplay change. The Doom-guard logic in that commit lives in upstream base classes this fork does not track.
v0.1.0.11 - 2026-08-03: Fixed per-frame 'no rotation found' log spam outside PvP (issue #3) - UpdateCustomRotation returns early when not in PvP and the remaining no-rotation warnings are throttled.
